name: Ursa Major II Dwarf
tagline: One of the faintest galaxies known — an ultra-faint Milky Way satellite only ~105,000 light-years out.

facts.label: Luminosity
facts.value: Among the least luminous galaxies known

history: Ursa Major II ranks among the faintest objects ever called a galaxy — a 2006 SDSS find closer in than most halo dwarfs, its handful of old stars moving fast enough to reveal a huge dark-matter halo underneath. Objects like UMa II mark the threshold where galaxy formation fades into pure dark halos, and their extreme dark densities make them targets in the search for dark-matter annihilation signals.
